name: PillNav-TS-TW

frames.best_why: Shows the logo and the full pill row crisply, with no hover animation blurring the labels.
frames.render_note: The left edge is cropped: the Home pill falls outside the frame in every shot.

tagline: Rounded white pills sit in a bar; the hovered one fills with a dark circle.
summary: A slim top navigation with a round logo and a row of small pill links. Hovering a pill grows a circle that fills it and flips the label to white, while the active link shows a dot beneath.
appearance: A thin dark band at the top holds a round photo logo on the left and a white capsule bar of small uppercase pill links split by thin gaps. Each pill has dark text, and the active link carries a small round dot just below its pill.
behaviour: Hovering a pill expands a circle from its base that fills the pill and flips the label to the hover colour; leaving shrinks it back. The logo spins once on hover, and below a breakpoint the links fold behind a two-line hamburger that opens a stacked menu.
demo_content: Links Home, About, Work, Blog and Contact beside a small photo logo.
search_phrases: rounded navigation bar with pill links
top nav with sliding circle hover
minimal site menu with dot under active page
capsule shaped tab bar for a site
hover fills the menu item with a circle
small uppercase links in a white bar
responsive nav with hamburger on mobile
logo and menu links across the top
use_when: You want a compact, friendly primary menu that stays small but makes each link feel tactile on hover.
avoid_when: It relies on hover for the circle effect, so touch users get plain pills, and the tiny uppercase text limits legibility.
customise: You pass the logo URL, alt text and an array of label/href items, plus the active href and five colour props for base, pill, text and hover text. Spacing, sizes and the mobile layout are fixed.
weight_why: A handful of GSAP tweens on tiny pills; nothing animates until hover or a menu toggle.

a11y.note: Hover and menu animations ignore reduced-motion, and menuitem roles on plain links promise arrow-key behaviour that is not there.

issues: The nav overflows the stage crop, so the Home pill is clipped off the left edge in every frame.
Mid-hover frames show the label duplicated and overlapping while the circle grows.
role=menuitem sits on ordinary links without the arrow-key menu behaviour it implies.
polish_why: Crisp compact pills and a tidy hover fill, but clipped at the left edge and plain at rest.
title: Pill Nav
